_comment: [claude] LangGraph API server config. `langgraph dev` reads this, and
LangGraph Studio connects to that server.
`marq_agent` is the one to use: it routes each question to the domain
specialist that owns it. The two domain graphs are exposed alongside it
so a single agent can be exercised in isolation when debugging — pick
These point at build_*_studio_graph rather than app/graph/graph.py:graph
because the server supplies its own persistence — a checkpointer compiled
into the graph competes with it.
`env` selects the environment file. Change it if APP_ENV is not development.
